description: This file defines the AssetMovement class for handling asset transfer, issue, receipt, and related validation and update logic within an ERP system, including methods for validation, submission, cancellation, and updating asset location and custodian.

classes.name: AssetMovement
classes.description: Represents an asset movement record with validation, submission, and cancellation logic for asset transfer, issue, receipt, and location updates.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of asset, location, and employee data before submission.

methods.name: validate_asset
methods.description: Validates asset status, ownership, and presence of location or employee data.

methods.name: validate_location
methods.description: Validates source and target locations, employee assignments, and movement purpose constraints.

methods.name: validate_employee
methods.description: Validates that the custodian and employee data are consistent with asset and company records.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles logic to execute when the asset movement is submitted, updating asset location and custodian.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles logic to execute when the asset movement is canceled, reverting asset location and custodian.

methods.name: set_latest_location_in_asset
methods.description: Updates the latest location and custodian of assets based on the most recent movement entry.
